Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner imposed an incorrect methodology by (a) restricting comparison to USA release dates despite the task not specifying country and (b) instructing to use the latest USA date as the “canonical” release date. To answer “which was released earlier,” one should compare the earliest verified release dates (globally). This flawed normalization would bias dates later and risk concluding the wrong film as earlier, ignoring Xenoa’s clear 2007 Philippine release.
